info.title: Pipelinq CRM Register
info.description: Client Relationship Management register for the Pipelinq Nextcloud app. Manages clients, contacts, leads, requests, and pipelines.
info.x-changelog: 1.9.0: ticket gains portalAnswers (every answer the handler sent to the customer, oldest first, each with when it was sent), so a resident reads on the portal what was answered and when, not only the latest customerMessage without a date (question-detail-on-the-portal). ticket schema version 1.3.1->1.4.0. 1.8.1: ticket.portalSubject also scopes a resident's own request and complaint filed from the portal (createOwnRequest, createOwnComplaint), so a DigiD resident without a clientId claim reads what they filed; description and x-notes only, no property added. ticket schema version 1.3.0->1.3.1. 1.8.0: ticket lifecycle allows every move a dossier question makes: convert also from new and awaiting_customer, a new await (new, in_progress -> awaiting_customer) and resume (awaiting_customer -> in_progress). Without them OpenRegister refused converting a question, saving an answer that waits for the resident, and the resident's reply (found by the Woo journey e2e). ticket schema version 1.2.0->1.3.0. 1.7.0: ticket gains portalSubject (the portal reference of the resident who asked, never a BSN) and subjectReference (a snapshot of the opencatalogi dossier a question is about: type, id, title, items with title and url), so a resident can ask about their Woo dossier from the portal and the KCC employee sees what they saw (questions-about-a-citizen-dossier, hydra woo-citizen-journey C4). ticket schema version 1.1.0->1.2.0. 1.6.1: lead swaps its AccountArrowRightOutline icon for CashMultiple. A lead is a deal, not a person: the person is the contact, which carries the people icon, and two adjacent surfaces reading as the same thing is a rebrand the icon never got. lead schema version 1.4.0->1.4.1; declaration only, no property changed. 1.5.0: pipeline gains propertyMappings — which object types the pipeline boards and which property supplies the stage column. The pipeline editor already wrote this array and PipelineBoard/PipelineManager already read it, but the schema never declared it, so magic-table storage dropped every mapping a user configured: the board resolved no object types and the create forms, filtering on the retired entityType field, offered no pipeline at all. A pipeline declaring no mappings is unscoped, not inapplicable. pipeline schema version 3.1.0->3.2.0. 1.4.0: timeEntry gains user (Nextcloud uid / imported identity performing the work — distinct from approvedBy, needed for per-person hour reporting and migrated worklogs) and metadata (declared object catch-all for source-system provenance such as tempoWorklogId/jiraIssueKey/migratedAt — declared explicitly because magic-table storage drops undeclared properties). timeEntry schema version 1.1.0->1.2.0. 1.3.0: Loyalty vocabulary completed. Schema slug klantLoyaltyAccount->customerLoyaltyAccount (@type KlantLoyaltyAccount->CustomerLoyaltyAccount), and the last two Dutch property keys in the loyalty fragment: loyaltyProgramme.merk->brand, loyaltyProgramme.valuta->currency, giftCard.valuta->currency. Both keys are added to RenameDutchColumns so existing rows move with the declaration. The oc_appconfig key klantLoyaltyAccount_schema deliberately does NOT move: it is derived from the slug, so it is pinned in SettingsLoadService::SCHEMA_CONFIG_KEYS rather than left to follow the rename. 1.2.2: Re-authored 2 Dutch schema-level titles to English (klantLoyaltyAccount "Klant Loyalty Account"->"Customer Loyalty Account", nrcAbonnement "NRC Abonnement"->"NRC Subscription"); Dutch labels now live in l10n/nl.json + nl.js. VNG Klantinteracties and Kassakoppeling schema titles kept as-is (formal standard / established domain terms). No property titles, keys, enums, or other fields changed. 1.2.1: Re-authored 38 Dutch schema property titles to English (contact.geheimhouding plus the bsnValidatie, brpLookupVerzoek, brpPersoon, bsnAuditRecord, and optOutVlag schemas); Dutch labels now live in l10n/nl.json + nl.js. No property keys, enums, or other fields changed.

lead.title: Lead
lead.summary: A sales lead or business opportunity
lead.description: Represents a sales lead: a potential deal or business opportunity linked to a client. Tracks value, probability, pipeline stage, and lifecycle status. Mapped to Schema.org Demand.

search.description: Search sales leads/opportunities, optionally filtered by lifecycle status, pipeline stage, or associated client. Returns RBAC-scoped lead summaries, newest first, including the declarative qualificationScore, weightedValue, and recency-decayed winProbability calculated fields.

get.description: Get a single lead by id, including the declarative qualificationScore, weightedValue, and recency-decayed winProbability calculated fields materialised by OpenRegister.

win.description: Close the lead as won. Authorization: assignee or a member of the sales group.

lose.description: Close the lead as lost. Authorization: assignee or a member of the sales group.

daysSinceActivity.description: Staleness: days since the lead was last touched. Derived from @self.updated (the object's last save) so it is always fresh on read; lead-management spec staleness scenario (Scenario 49). A consumer flags the lead as stale when this exceeds the configured threshold.

daysInStage.description: Aging: days the lead has spent in its current pipeline stage. Diffs stageEnteredAt against now; falls back to @self.created when the stage-change writer has not yet populated stageEnteredAt (lead-management spec Aging Indicator, Scenario 50/51).

weightedValue.description: Probability-weighted lead value (value * probability / 100). Single-object derived figure feeding the Pipeline Value KPI. NOTE: the lead-management spec's 'lead value from line items' sum (Scenario: Calculate lead value from line items) is a cross-schema aggregation over leadProduct rows and is NOT expressible as a single-object calculation. It remains a service/frontend concern per ADR-031 exception (2).

qualificationScore.description: Backend qualification score (0-100), materialised on every save. Resolves the lead-management spec 'frontend vs backend qualification score' open question: the score is a backend calculation; the frontend reads it. Point weights mirror the spec's default scoring criteria (Scenario: Auto-calculate qualification score on lead save): value present +10, value above EUR 10000 +20, client linked +15, contact linked +10, source referral/partner +15, expectedCloseDate set +10, priority high/urgent +10, description present +5.

winProbability.description: Recency-decayed win probability (0-100): the lead's stage-denormalised `probability`, decayed by inactivity (full <=14d, 80% <=30d, 50% <=60d, else 25%). materialise:false so a stalling deal cools on read with no write. Single-object (ADR-031): reads @self.updated + the lead's own probability only.

message.description: Free-text enquiry message from the submitter (anonymous website intake)
message.title: Message

client.description: UUID reference to the associated client
client.title: Client

contact.description: UUID reference to the associated contact person
contact.title: Contact

source.description: Origin of the lead (e.g., website, referral, cold-call, advertisement, event)
source.title: Source

category.title: Category
category.description: What the lead is about, such as vergunningen. Suggested agents are colleagues with a skill for this category.

value.description: Estimated deal value, in the lead currency or else the reporting currency (schema:price)
value.title: Lead Value

expectedCloseDate.description: Expected close date for the opportunity
expectedCloseDate.title: Expected Close Date

assignee.description: Nextcloud user UID of the assigned sales representative
assignee.title: Assignee

pipeline.description: UUID reference to the pipeline this lead is tracked in
pipeline.title: Pipeline

stageOrder.description: Numeric position of the current stage in the pipeline
stageOrder.title: Stage Order

decisions.title: Decisions
decisions.description: Governance decisions raised for this deal (e.g. approval to close above a threshold). References decidesk Decision objects (ADR-066 cross-app relation); Decidesk owns the making and eIDAS signing. Link an existing decision or create one in Decidesk from the lead.

description.description: Free-text description of the opportunity (used by the qualification-score calculation: presence is worth +5 points)
description.title: Description

stageEnteredAt.description: Timestamp the lead entered its current pipeline stage. Set by the stage-change writer; the aging calculation diffs this against now. When unset, aging falls back to @self.created.
stageEnteredAt.title: Stage Entered At

qualificationScore.description: Backend-computed qualification score (0-100). Materialised by the x-openregister-calculations.qualificationScore annotation on every save: never written by service code. Resolves the lead-management spec 'frontend vs backend qualification score' open question in favour of a backend calculation.
qualificationScore.title: Qualification Score

pipeline.title: Pipeline
pipeline.summary: A thin CRM pipeline config mapping stage rules onto a Deck board
pipeline.description: Represents a CRM pipeline configuration: maps pipeline stages to a Deck board and its stacks, preserving CRM-specific semantics (probability, won/closed/default flags) that Deck itself does not model. Board mechanics (columns, cards, drag-and-drop) are provided by the OpenRegister deck leaf. Mapped to Schema.org ItemList.

deckBoardId.description: NC Deck board ID that this pipeline is realised as
deckBoardId.title: Deck Board ID

propertyMappings.description: Which object types this pipeline boards, and which property of each supplies the stage column. A pipeline that declares none is unscoped and offered for every entity type. Supersedes the retired `entityType` field.

schemaSlug.description: Logical entity slug boarded here ('lead', 'request', …). Ticket subtypes resolve onto the unified `ticket` schema via resolveObjectType().
schemaSlug.title: Schema slug

columnProperty.description: Object property whose value names the stage column (normally 'stage').
columnProperty.title: Column property

totalsProperty.description: Optional numeric property summed per column for a stage total (e.g. 'value').
totalsProperty.title: Totals property

propertyMappings.title: Property mappings

stages.description: Ordered list of CRM stage rules mapped onto Deck stacks (schema:ItemListElement)

deckStackId.description: NC Deck stack ID that this stage is mapped to
deckStackId.title: Deck Stack ID

probability.description: Default win probability percentage for this stage (0-100)
probability.title: Probability

isClosed.description: Whether this stage represents a closed/terminal state
isClosed.title: Is Closed

isWon.description: Whether this closed stage represents a won/successful outcome. Only valid when isClosed is true.
isWon.title: Is Won

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default entry stage for new leads/requests in this pipeline
isDefault.title: Default Pipeline

stages.title: Stages

isDefault.description: Whether this is the default pipeline for its entity type
isDefault.title: Default Pipeline

leadProduct.title: Lead Product
leadProduct.summary: A line item linking a product to a lead
leadProduct.description: Represents a product line item on a lead: an instance of a product with deal-specific quantity, pricing, and discount. The total is computed as quantity * unitPrice * (1 - discount/100). Mapped to Schema.org Offer.

create.description: Add a priced line to a lead: one product with its quantity, unit price and optional discount. This is how an offer/quotation is built: create the lead first (pipelinq_createLead), then add one line per product. Do NOT send `total`: it is calculated by OpenRegister as quantity * unitPrice minus the discount (percent or amount, per discountType), so a supplied value would be overwritten and any figure quoted from it would be wrong.

search.description: List the priced lines on a lead: the body of an offer/quotation. Filter by `lead` to get one offer's lines. Each line carries the materialised `total`.

get.description: Get a single offer line by id, including its materialised `total`.

lead.description: The deal this line belongs to.

product.description: Pick a product, or type a new name to create one. Its price and unit pre-fill the line.
product.title: Product

unitPrice.description: Price per unit (pre-filled from the Product, can be overridden)
unitPrice.title: Unit Price

unit.description: Unit of measure for this line (e.g. hours, pieces, m2). Pre-filled from the product.
unit.title: Unit

Expired (never-actioned) tasks carry little record value; 1-year retention for audit, then disposed. DPO sign-off pending.

categories.title: Categories

isActive.description: Whether this skill is active for routing

posTransaction.title: POS Transaction
posTransaction.summary: A point-of-sale transaction (kassabon) with lifecycle, totals and tax breakdown
posTransaction.description: Represents a POS cart / receipt from open (draft) through payment (confirmed -> settled) or cancellation (refunded). The taxBreakdown array captures tax per VAT rate so receipts can show 9% and 21% lines separately. Totals are server-computed by PosTransactionService and must never be trusted from the client. Mapped to Schema.org Order.

confirm.description: Confirm a draft or parked cart. Authorization: the cashier who owns the transaction, a member of the POS group, or an admin. The server recomputes totals and rejects an empty cart.

settle.description: Mark a confirmed transaction as paid. Authorization: the cashier, a POS-group member, or an admin.

park.description: Park a draft cart for later. Authorization: the cashier, a POS-group member, or an admin.

resume.description: Resume a parked cart to draft. Authorization: the cashier, a POS-group member, or an admin.

refund.description: Refund / void a confirmed or settled transaction. Authorization: a POS manager (member of the configured manager group) or an admin only.

cashier.description: Nextcloud user UID of the logged-in cashier
cashier.title: Cashier

staffMemberId.description: Optional UUID reference to the posStaff member who was actively logged in at the POS terminal when this transaction was confirmed. Drives per-staff sales reporting and the shillinq commission feed (pos-staff-pin-permissions).
staffMemberId.title: Staff member

client.description: Optional UUID reference to a client object for account sales
client.title: Client

customer.description: Optional UUID reference to a pipelinq contact attached to this transaction (POS customer link). When tenderType is 'onAccount' this field is required and enforced server-side by PosCustomerLinkService.
customer.title: Customer

marketingConsent.description: Marketing opt-in captured at checkout. When true and customer is set, PosCustomerLinkService syncs the flag onto the linked contact (unless the contact carries doNotContact).
marketingConsent.title: Marketing consent

tenderType.description: Tender / payment method used to settle the transaction. 'onAccount' marks an AR (debtor) sale and requires a linked customer.
tenderType.title: Tender type

consentSyncStatus.description: Status of the last marketingConsent sync to the linked pipelinq contact: 'pending' (no sync attempted yet), 'success', 'skipped' (do-not-contact), or 'failed'. Defaults to 'pending' rather than an empty string: OpenRegister coerces a stored empty string back to null, and the TransitionEngine's whole-object re-save (confirm/settle/refund/park/resume) then fails strict validation with "should be type 'string' but is 'null'". A non-empty default persists and keeps the lifecycle transitions working.
consentSyncStatus.title: Consent Sync Status

terminalId.description: POS terminal / register identifier, e.g. kassa-01

priceMode.title: Price mode

totalTax.description: Aggregate tax amount, sum of taxBreakdown[*].tax (server-computed)

notes.description: Optional line-level notes, e.g. inclusief montage

refundReason.title: Refund Reason
refundReason.summary: A configurable reason code for a POS refund / return
refundReason.description: Lookup / enumeration of standard refund reasons (damaged, unwanted, wrong item, expired, cashier error, other). Managers can mark reasons active/inactive to control which appear in refund forms. Mapped to Schema.org DefinedTerm.

description.description: Help text shown in the refund form
description.title: Description

isActive.description: Whether this reason is available for new refunds
isActive.title: Active

icon.description: Optional icon identifier for the reason
icon.title: Icon

posRefund.title: POS Refund
posRefund.summary: A refund / return document for a previously settled or confirmed POS transaction
posRefund.description: Represents a full or partial refund against a posTransaction. refundAmount and totalTax are server-computed by PosRefundService from the refund lines and the original transaction's persisted, server-authoritative tax data; client-supplied amounts are never trusted. Lifecycle: pending -> completed (manager confirm) or pending -> rejected. Completed and rejected refunds are immutable. Mapped to Schema.org Order (type=refund).

complete.description: Confirm a pending refund (emits reversal + stock events). Authorization: a POS manager or admin only. The cumulative over-refund cap is enforced and amounts are recomputed server-side.

reject.description: Reject a pending refund. Authorization: a POS manager or admin only.

originalTransaction.description: UUID reference to the original posTransaction being refunded
originalTransaction.title: Original transaction

cashier.description: Nextcloud user UID of the cashier processing the return
cashier.title: Cashier

refundReason.description: UUID reference to a refundReason describing the overall reason
refundReason.title: Refund reason

paymentMethod.description: Original tender method (cash, card_visa, card_mastercard, digital_wallet)
paymentMethod.title: Payment method

paymentReference.description: Transaction id from the original payment, used for tender reversal reference
paymentReference.title: Payment Reference

refundAmount.description: Total refund amount excl. tax (server-computed from refund lines)
refundAmount.title: Refund Amount

totalTax.description: Aggregate tax being refunded (server-computed from refund lines)
totalTax.title: Total Tax

rejectionReason.description: Text reason if the refund was rejected
rejectionReason.title: Rejection Reason

cloudEventId.description: CloudEvents id of the emitted refund reversal event
cloudEventId.title: Cloud Event ID

posRefundLine.title: POS Refund Line
posRefundLine.summary: One returnable item on a posRefund, linked to the original transaction line
posRefundLine.description: A single returned item on a posRefund. taxAmount and lineTotal are server-computed proportionally from the original posTransactionLine and the returned quantity; client-supplied amounts are never trusted. restock controls whether a stock back-in event is emitted to Shillinq on completion. Mapped to Schema.org OrderItem (type=refund-line).

refund.description: UUID reference to the parent posRefund
refund.title: Refund

originalLine.description: UUID reference to the original posTransactionLine being refunded
originalLine.title: Original Line

returnedQuantity.description: Number of units being refunded (supports fractions)
returnedQuantity.title: Returned Quantity

returnReason.description: UUID reference to a refundReason for this specific item
returnReason.title: Return reason

restock.description: Whether the returned item should be restored to inventory
restock.title: Restock

notes.description: Line-specific return notes, e.g. dent on back corner
notes.title: Notes

posRole.title: POS Role
posRole.summary: A named set of POS terminal permissions assignable to staff members
posRole.description: Defines a permission matrix (canVoid, maxDiscountPercent, canRefund, canNoSale) that can be assigned to one or many posStaff records. The role drives action gates on the POS terminal: any operator whose active session resolves to a role without the relevant flag is blocked from the protected action. Mapped to Schema.org Role.

name.description: Role display name, e.g. Kassamedewerker, Supervisor, Manager
name.title: Name

description.description: Optional description of the role's purpose and scope
description.title: Description

canVoid.description: Whether the role may void a completed transaction
canVoid.title: Can void

maxDiscountPercent.description: Maximum line-item discount percentage this role may apply (0-100)
maxDiscountPercent.title: Max discount %

canRefund.description: Whether the role may process a refund / return
canRefund.title: Can refund

canNoSale.description: Whether the role may open the cash drawer without a transaction (no-sale)
canNoSale.title: Can no-sale

posStaff.title: POS Staff
posStaff.summary: A POS terminal operator with a PIN, role assignment and active/inactive flag
posStaff.description: Represents a POS operator. PIN is stored as a bcrypt hash and NEVER returned by any API. failedPinAttempts and lockedUntil implement the 5-attempt / 15-minute lockout. userId is an optional link to a Nextcloud account; not every operator needs an NC user. Mapped to Schema.org Person (POS operator role).

displayName.description: Operator name shown on the terminal header after login
displayName.title: Display name

userId.description: Optional Nextcloud user UID linking this operator to an NC account
userId.title: Nextcloud user

posRole.description: UUID reference to the operator's posRole
posRole.title: POS role

pinHash.description: Bcrypt hash of the 4-6 digit PIN. Write-only: never returned by any API response.
pinHash.title: PIN Hash

isActive.description: Whether this staff member is allowed to log in
isActive.title: Active

failedPinAttempts.description: Consecutive failed PIN attempts (reset on success; lockout at 5)
failedPinAttempts.title: Failed PIN Attempts

lockedUntil.description: ISO 8601 timestamp until which PIN login is blocked after 5 failed attempts
lockedUntil.title: Locked Until

lastLoginAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent successful PIN login
lastLoginAt.title: Last Login At

receiptTemplate.title: Receipt Template
receiptTemplate.description: Configures how a POS receipt is rendered: company header/footer, layout width and whether the legal-invoice (VAT) variant applies. The body is a safe placeholder template ({{ placeholder }} tokens only: no expression evaluation), so a malicious template cannot execute code or trigger SSRF.

body.description: Receipt body template using {{ placeholder }} tokens only (no expression evaluation). Optional: when empty a built-in default layout is used.
body.title: Receipt Body

layoutWidth.description: Thermal printer line width in characters
layoutWidth.title: Layout Width

companyLogoUrl.description: Optional URL to a company logo for the receipt header
companyLogoUrl.title: Company Logo URL

isInvoiceMode.description: When true, always render the legal-invoice (VAT breakdown + compliance footer) variant. Transactions >= EUR 100 render as an invoice regardless of this flag.
isInvoiceMode.title: Invoice Mode

organizationId.description: Optional UUID of the owning organization for multi-tenant isolation
organizationId.title: Organization ID

receiptPrintLog.title: Receipt Print Log
receiptPrintLog.summary: An append-only audit entry for a printed or emailed POS receipt
receiptPrintLog.description: Immutable audit trail of every receipt print and email action for compliance. Entries are append-only and never updated after creation. Mapped to Schema.org Action.

transaction.description: UUID reference to the posTransaction the receipt was issued for
transaction.title: Transaction

template.description: UUID reference to the receiptTemplate used (may be empty for the default layout)
template.title: Template

printerDevice.description: Configured printer IP:port or device name (for print actions)
printerDevice.title: Printer Device

actor.description: Nextcloud user UID of the user who performed the action
actor.title: Actor

renderedContent.description: The rendered receipt content captured for audit
renderedContent.title: Rendered Content

invoiceNumber.description: Server-issued legal invoice number recorded with this action (empty for non-invoice receipts). Used to prove a number on a transaction was server-issued, not client-forged.
invoiceNumber.title: Invoice Number

errorMessage.description: Human-readable error detail when status is failed
errorMessage.title: Error Message

paymentProvider.title: Payment Provider
paymentProvider.summary: Configuration record for a POS payment provider (Mollie, CCV, Adyen, Stripe)
paymentProvider.description: Per-provider configuration record for the pluggable POS payment adapter. Encrypted credential fields (apiKey, apiSecret, webhookSecret) are stored encrypted in IAppConfig; this object only mirrors metadata + masked indicators for the admin UI. Mapped to Schema.org PaymentService.

name.description: Provider identifier: mollie, ccv, adyen or stripe
name.title: Name

displayName.description: Human-readable provider name (Mollie, CCV, Adyen, Stripe)
displayName.title: Display name

type.description: Provider type: online (Mollie, Stripe) or terminal (CCV, Adyen)
type.title: Type

isActive.description: Whether this provider is enabled for transactions
isActive.title: Active

apiKey.description: Provider API key or secret: encrypted. Masked as ***SET*** in API responses.
apiKey.title: API Key

apiSecret.description: Additional secret for providers that require signing (e.g. CCV): encrypted. Masked in responses.
apiSecret.title: API Secret

webhookSecret.description: Webhook signature verification key from the provider: encrypted. Masked in responses.
webhookSecret.title: Webhook Secret

testMode.description: If true, payment requests use test/dummy amounts for validation without charging
testMode.title: Test mode

config.description: Provider-specific nested config: e.g. { terminalId: "kassa-01", merchantAccount: "..." }
config.title: Provider Config

lastTestedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last connection test
lastTestedAt.title: Last Tested At

testResult.description: Result of the last connection test: { status: ok|error, message: "..." }
testResult.title: Test Result

bsnValidatie.title: BSN Validation
bsnValidatie.description: Onveranderlijk resultaat van een 11-proef controle (RvIG-algoritme). Wordt aangemaakt bij elke validatie-poging (server-side audit). BSN wordt gemaskeerd opgeslagen (***XXXX*): raw BSN gaat NOOIT in een bsnValidatie-object.

enteredBsn.description: Gemaskeerd BSN: pattern ***XXXX* (eerste 3 + laatste 1 vervangen door ***). Raw 9-cijferig BSN wordt NIET opgeslagen.
enteredBsn.title: BSN (masked)

elevenTestScore.description: Intermediaire score (sum mod 11) voor debugging. 0 = geldig.
elevenTestScore.title: Eleven-test score

initiatedBy.description: Nextcloud user UID die de validatie initieerde
initiatedBy.title: Initiated by

context.description: Waar de validatie gebeurde: contact-aanmaken, avg-request, vog-screening, brp-lookup
context.title: Context

requestId.description: UUID van gekoppeld Pipelinq verzoek (request, complaint) indien van toepassing
requestId.title: Request ID

brpLookupVerzoek.title: BRP Lookup Request
brpLookupVerzoek.summary: Een aangevraagde BRP-lookup met doelbinding (persistent voor audit)
brpLookupVerzoek.description: Het verzoek zelf: vastgelegd met doelbinding en wettelijke grondslag voor audit. BSN wordt GEHASHED opgeslagen (SHA-256). De aangevraagde BSN-waarde is alleen kort in het geheugen aanwezig tijdens de lookup.

bsnHash.description: SHA-256 hash van het BSN (NOOIT raw BSN). Hex-string van 64 chars.
bsnHash.title: BSN-hash

verzoekreden.description: Standaard- of vrij tekstveld: AVG-artikel, VOG, overig
verzoekreden.title: Request reason

purposeBinding.description: Wettelijke grondslag (AVG art. 6, Wet BRP art. 3.3 lid 1, etc.)
purposeBinding.title: Purpose binding

basis.description: Publieke taak, rechtsplicht, gerechtvaardigd belang, etc.
basis.title: Legal basis

linkedRequest.description: UUID-referentie naar Pipelinq verzoek (request, complaint, etc.)
linkedRequest.title: Linked Request

haalcentraalCorrelationId.description: Tracking ID van HaalCentraal voor support / trace
haalcentraalCorrelationId.title: Haalcentraal Correlation ID

responseInCache.description: True als deze lookup van cache kwam
responseInCache.title: Response In Cache

brpPersoon.title: BRP Person
brpPersoon.summary: Genormaliseerde response uit HaalCentraal — versleuteld at-rest met TTL
brpPersoon.description: Persoonsgegevens uit HaalCentraal BRP, genormaliseerd. Gekoppeld aan Contact. Versleuteld at-rest (Nextcloud native encryption). RetentieTot stuurt het BrpRetentionJob: record wordt automatisch verwijderd na ingestelde periode (default 7 dagen na verzoek-afsluiting).

bsnHash.description: SHA-256 hash van BSN (NOOIT raw BSN persistent). Hex-string van 64 chars.
bsnHash.title: BSN-hash

namePrefix.description: Voorvoegsel: vd, de, van, van der, etc.
namePrefix.title: Name Prefix

fetchedOn.description: ISO 8601 wanneer dit Persoon-record van HaalCentraal kwam
fetchedOn.title: Retrieved At

retentionTo.description: ISO 8601 datum/tijd tot hoelang dit record mag bestaan. BrpRetentionJob verwijdert records waar retentieTot < now.
retentionTo.title: Retention Until

bsnAuditRecord.title: BSN Audit Record
bsnAuditRecord.summary: Onveranderlijke audit-regel voor BSN-bevragingen (5 jaar bewaard per RvIG)
bsnAuditRecord.description: Audit-trail voor elke BRP-lookup, ongeacht uitkomst. Immutable: true. Kan NIET worden gewijzigd of verwijderd via standaard CRUD. Alleen het systeem mag bij Right-to-be-forgotten pseudonimiseren (BSN-hash blijft, raw BSN-waarde gaat dan op SHA-256). Bewaartot = now + 5 jaar (RvIG-richtlijn).

bsnHash.description: SHA-256 hash van BSN (NOOIT raw). Hex-string van 64 chars. Gepseudonimiseerd na RTBF.
bsnHash.title: BSN-hash

actorRole.description: Rol of groep van actor (behandelaar-burgerzaken, behandelaar-avg, beheerder)
actorRole.title: Actor Role

ipAddress.description: Requester IP, geanonimiseerd (laatste octet vervangen door 0)
ipAddress.title: IP Address

vogScreening.description: True als dit voor VOG-screening was (extra Justis-vlag)
vogScreening.title: VOG Screening

retainUntil.description: ISO 8601 tot hoelang dit record bewaard moet blijven (default now + 5 jaar)
retainUntil.title: Retention Until

optOutVlag.title: Opt-out / Confidentiality Flag
optOutVlag.summary: Per BSN bekende opt-out of geheimhouding (BRP of lokaal)
optOutVlag.description: Wordt aangemaakt uit BRP-response (indicatieGeheim=1) of handmatig door medewerker (lokale-contact-opt-out). Verbergt adresgegevens, blokkeert doorgifte aan derden volgens beperkt-restricties.

bsnHash.description: SHA-256 hash van BSN (NOOIT raw). Hex-string van 64 chars.
bsnHash.title: BSN-hash

source.description: BRP (automatisch uit response) of lokaal (handmatig opgevoerd)
source.title: Source

effectiveDate.description: ISO 8601 date wanneer opt-out van kracht werd
effectiveDate.title: Effective Date

endDate.description: ISO 8601 date wanneer opt-out afloopt (null = onbeperkt)
endDate.title: End Date

limited.description: Array van restricties: commerciele-derden, kerkgenootschappen, derdeportalen
limited.title: Restrictions

localEnteredBy.description: Nextcloud user UID van wie de opt-out lokaal registreerde
localEnteredBy.title: Registered By

note.description: Vrije toelichting (bijv. "verzoek burger per formulier X")
note.title: Note

default-pipeline-view.description: Default view for pipeline boards: includes leads and requests from the Pipelinq register
